name: mask-full-probe-v21a
purpose: per-cell rear-eligibility mask net for the HSSR upmix (hook/audio/hssr_mask.c); eligibility = p_other of a 5-role softmax (vocals, drum_core, cymbals, bass, other)
format: HSSRMSK1: 8-byte magic, u32 float count, float32 LE arrays in spa_mask_assign() order
architecture: full_probe (mask_net.py --arch full_probe): stem conv5 -> 3 depthwise-stride-2 stages -> flatten -> GRU(64) -> global/local/presence heads -> per-cell decoder 57-32-32-5; ~128 M MAC/s at 93.75 controls/s
training: mask_net.py, run masknet-v21a (PC D:\upmix\runs\masknet-v21a), MoisesDB train split via masknet_cache7, 2026-09-26; export: python3 mask_net.py export-blob --model masknet-v21a/mask_net.pt --out v21a.msk1
runtime_arithmetic: decoder int8 (per-row weight scales, one dynamic input scale per control); vs the float runtime max |delta eligibility| 0.017, corr 0.99991
dev_result_2026_09_27: 40 MoisesDB DEV songs through the production path (stereo_upmix_render --mask-model --mask-drive-prod 1.0 --vocal-gate 0.5): vocals rear share 0.04 (0/40 > 15 %, 2/40 swinging), guitar 0.07, other_keys 0.08, piano 0.04, bass 0.07, drums 0.17, rear -37.5 dBFS, rear error vs oracle 0.16 (gain-fit 0.15); the int8 build identical
pick: v27a and v29a tie on share but swing more (v27a: vocals 4/40, guitars 3/39, drums 3/40; v29a: 3/40, 3/39, keys 2/27) vs v21a 2/40, 1/39, keys 1/27, drums 0/40
